selected_evidence.summary: useradd succeeded and id/getent passwd show appworker (uid 1000) both immediately after creation and after the node restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
selected_evidence.summary: limits.d/appworker.conf sets soft/hard nofile 8192 and soft/hard nproc 256; `su -l appworker` ulimit checks show exactly 8192/8192/256/256 both pre- and post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart with changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e captured, reboot acknowledged then node became unreachable (timeout/connection reset), then reachable again with new boot_id 400bd08f-5873-456c-9f19-218df0fbdee8, proving a genuine restart
After the restart, appworker account, the limits.d drop-in, and effective enforced ulimits (8192 files / 256 processes) were all confirmed intact via a fresh login shell

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline: node identity =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s

echo "== create appworker user =="
if id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "appworker already exists"
else
  sudo -n useradd -m appworker
  echo "created appworker"
fi
id appworker

echo "== write limits.d drop-in =="
sudo -n tee /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
EOF
cat /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf

echo "== verify via su login shell =="
sudo -n su -l appworker -c 'ulimit -Hn; ulimit -Sn; ulimit -Hu; ulimit -Su'
